description: Asking what a specific process has been writing to the system log maps to system/system_log with a process filter — not the process domain (which is about resource usage, not log output). Read-only; bounded to a short recent window.
prompt: Show me what the bluetoothd process has written to the system log in the last few minutes.

description: Asking which processes are using the most CPU right this second maps to process/top_processes (a live top sample), distinct from list_processes (ps's averaged snapshot). Read-only, no external dependency.
prompt: Which processes are hammering my CPU right now, this very second? Give me a live snapshot.

description: Asking whether the Mac is being thermally throttled maps to system/thermal_state, not power_status (battery/charging) or top_processes (per-process load). Read-only, fixed argv.
prompt: Is my Mac's CPU being throttled right now because it's running hot?
